packageRules.description: jest 28+ and its types need TypeScript 5 (jest 30's @types pull in .d.ts TS 4.9 cannot parse) and a Node-compatible probot stack; this dormant app is pinned to the jest 27 toolchain. Lift when the app is modernized.
jest-watch-typeahead 2+ and jest-watch-toggle-config 3+ require newer jest; stay on versions compatible with jest 27.
jest-watch-toggle-config 3+ requires newer jest; stay on 2.x with jest 27.
eslint 9+ defaults to flat config and eslint 10 removes .eslintrc and --ext, which this repo's lint setup uses; needs a flat-config migration first.
@types/node 18+ declarations do not parse under TypeScript 4.9 (build: 1493 errors); stay on 17 until the app moves to a newer TypeScript.
